Hana (partnerships): quick convo: partners keep getting surprised by minor SDK bumps (1.4.x -> 1.5.0) that change request serialisation. propose a formal "minor-deprecation" cadence: announce minor API-affecting changes 30 days before cut, provide shim flagged builds, and require marketplace gateway compat test before publish. thoughts?
Ravi (eng): +1. We should define what qualifies as a 'minor deprecation' (non-breaking by semver but still requires partner work). Suggest: any change that alters wire format, default headers, or response keys.
Diane (product): agree, and add a partner preview window where we publish prerelease SDKs to a partner-only registry and add a compatibility badge in the marketplace listing. Partner preview length: 2 weeks.
Marcus (legal): check contracts: our standard terms only call out 'breaking changes' notice. If we declare "minor-deprecation" as a formal class, we should create a standard addendum template for marketplace vendors to acknowledge the preview cadence. I can draft.
Ola (devex): I'll own the shim pipeline if we go this route. Plan: publish shim packages scoped `@redwood/compat-1.5` that translate old->new for 30 days. Shims will emit header `X-RW-Compat: shim` so telemetry identifies traffic. ETA for pipeline: 3 weeks.
Priya (marketplace): marketplace policy: we can show a "compat status" badge (green/yellow/red) and a preview toggle for partners. Need eng hooks to run connector tests (test-suite runs) and a vendor opt-in flag.
CompatBot: @Hana created issue RNW-6980 "Define minor-deprecation cadence + marketplace gating" https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-6980
Hana (partnerships): concrete proposal: 30d announce + 14d partner preview + 30d shim support after enforcement. Partners get prerelease SDKs and a sandbox URL. Marketplace connectors must pass an automated compat-check during preview to get a "preview-ready" badge.
Ravi (eng): implementation notes: add feature-flag `compat.minor_vX` and an endpoint `/compat-check` that runs smoke tests against a connector. We'll also add log tag `minor_depr_vX` and daily partner export.
Diane (product): comms: partnerships to send partner-specific emails with migration steps and a short changelog. Docs will include mapping table, fallback examples, and recommended update path. I can draft the template.
Marcus (legal): I'll prepare a short consent snippet for marketplace vendor agreements so they acknowledge the preview period and our shim policy. No need for full contract renegotiation in most cases.
Ola (devex): shim snippet idea (JS): `const compat = require('@redwood/compat-1-5'); app.use(compat()) // logs X-RW-Compat` I'll make prerelease packages and a simple Helm chart for partners running in k8s.
Priya (marketplace): marketplace release flow: partners opt-in to preview, run compat-check, get preview badge, provide feedback, then pass to public listing after 2 weeks. We'll show deprecation timeline on the vendor dashboard.
Hana (partnerships): action items: partnerships to notify top 40 vendors on May 10. Diane to prepare changelog + email template by May 3. Ola to publish shim alpha May 12. Ravi to add `/compat-check` endpoint by May 8. Marcus to finish vendor consent snippet May 1. Priya to add badge + preview toggle in marketplace May 9.
Ravi (eng): will also add a daily CSV export of partners still on old SDKs so partnerships can prioritize outreach.
Diane (product): recommend a short webinar during the partner preview week and a one-page migration playbook for SIs.
Hana (partnerships): owners confirmed: partnerships=Hana, eng=Ravi, devex=Ola, product=Diane, legal=Marcus, marketplace=Priya. Please update RNW-6980 with owner + ETA.
Ola (devex): posting initial shim repo tomorrow and will open PRs for npm/pypi flows.
Priya (marketplace): I'll schedule marketplace vendor emails and add a dashboard card to track preview uptake.
All: :thumbsup:
